newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares end slightly lower after strong volume.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares end slightly lower after strong volume.

text.p: * NZ index slightly softer at close
* Good volume fails to spark prices
* Trade in leaders continues to dominate
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
312 +1 * NZSC cap index -1.56 at 4,959.77
348 -8 * Volume NZ$76 million. Futures untraded
654 -2 * Other movers - -5 -75
New Zealand shares closed mixed on good volume of about NZ$78 million on Thursday.
Brokers said turnover was strong ahead of a holiday on Friday, boosted by the early sale of 7.8 million Lyttelton Port company shares at $1.90 by two small local government holders.
Interest was centred on the index heavyweights but the good turnover failed to lift prices in all but a few selected stocks.
"The overall tone remains relatively muted, but volumes are quite a bit more healthy," broker Geoff Brown of Ord Minnett said.
At the close the NZSE40 Capital index was down 0.97 points at 2,253.57.
"The actual index move remains relatively disappointing after yesterday when it was up only six or so on a day when you would have expected it to be a little bit better," Brown said.
He said there was good volume in leaders Telecom, Brierley Investments, Lion Nathan and Fletcher Paper.
"Where we have seen buying it is mainly of leaders and mainly offshore driven rather than local."
June index futures closed at an unchanged 1125.
Features were the impact of good international paper prices on Fletcher Paper and Carter Holt Harvey. Brown said while CHH's share price made little headway, the stock was still well bid.
Lion Nathan rose to NZ$3.55 and sold back to $3.58 on reasonable volume ahead of its interim results due on Monday.
--Vernon Small, Wellington newsroom +64 4 473-4746
